contract.title: R03 satellite-network validity review
contract.goal: Act as a satellite-network and routing experiment reviewer. Check whether the 5 MHz versus 2 MHz pair can identify genuine directed-ISL pressure without confusing zero-rate, geometry, access, NO_ROUTE, queue overflow, control-plane failure, denominator change or incomplete drain. Check the no-pressure control requirement and adaptive next-step logic. Return PASS_WITH_LIMITS or REQUEST_CHANGES. Do not edit files or propose RL/matrix expansion.
acceptance: Verify both arms share all declared controlled conditions except ISL bandwidth.
Check pressure requires episode-coincident utilization and queueing on one directed link.
Check invalid-physics and drain branches precede pressure claims.
Check the control arm cannot already be pressured when claiming the 5-to-2 bracket.
requiredEvidence: At least one mechanism counterexample or covered test
